func work(_ i: Int) async {}
func isFree(_ i: Int) async -> Bool { i > 2 }
func log(_ s: String) {}

// CASE task_guard_return_only expect=pass
func s1(items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    Task {
      guard item > 0 else { return }
      await work(item)
    }
  }
}

// CASE task_guard_return_sibling expect=fire
func s2(items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    Task {
      guard item > 0 else { return }
      await work(item)
    }
    await work(item)
  }
}

// CASE task_return_value_handle expect=fire
func s3(items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task { () -> Int in
      if item < 0 { return 0 }
      await work(item)
      return item
    }
    _ = await task.value
  }
}

// CASE task_weak_self_guard expect=pass
final class Runner {
  func s4(items: [Int]) {
    for item in items {
      Task { [weak self] in
        guard let self else { return }
        await self.run(item)
      }
    }
  }
  func run(_ i: Int) async {}
}

// CASE detached_return_sibling expect=fire
func s5(items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    Task.detached(priority: .background) {
      if item < 0 { return }
      await work(item)
    }
    await work(item)
  }
}

// CASE generic_task_return_sibling expect=fire
func s6(items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    Task<Void, Never> {
      if item < 0 { return }
      await work(item)
    }
    await work(item)
  }
}

// CASE generic_task_return_only expect=pass
func s6b(items: [Int]) {
  for item in items {
    Task<Void, Never> {
      if item < 0 { return }
      await work(item)
    }
  }
}

// CASE add_task_return expect=pass
func s7(items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask {
        if item < 0 { return }
        await work(item)
      }
    }
  }
}

// CASE add_task_operation_capture_return expect=pass
func s8(items: [Int]) async {
  await withTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for item in items {
      group.addTask(operation: { [item] in
        guard item > 0 else { return }
        await work(item)
      })
    }
  }
}

// CASE map_return_then_await expect=fire
func s9(groups: [[Int]]) async {
  for group in groups {
    let doubled = group.map { x -> Int in return x * 2 }
    await work(doubled.count)
  }
}

// CASE guard_continue_then_await expect=fire
func s10(items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    guard item > 0 else { continue }
    await work(item)
  }
}

// CASE defer_then_await expect=fire
func s11(items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    defer { log("done") }
    await work(item)
  }
}

// CASE repeat_while_await expect=fire
func s12(items: [Int]) async {
  var i = 0
  repeat {
    await work(items[i])
    i += 1
  } while i < items.count
}

// CASE loop_early_return expect=pass
func s13(items: [Int]) async -> Int? {
  for item in items {
    if await isFree(item) { return item }
  }
  return nil
}

// CASE generic_task_apostrophe_brace_comment expect=pass
func s14(items: [Int]) {
  var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    tasks.append(Task<Void, Never> {
      // Don't wait here; the caller joins later. }
      await work(item)
    })
  }
  _ = tasks
}

// CASE task_return_in_nested_closure_sibling expect=fire
func s15(items: [[Int]]) async {
  for group in items {
    Task {
      let ok = group.contains { x in return x > 0 }
      if !ok { return }
      await work(group.count)
    }
    await work(group.count)
  }
}

// CASE task_handles_join_in_loop expect=fire
func s16(items: [Int]) async {
  var handles: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
  for item in items {
    handles.append(Task { await work(item) })
  }
  for handle in handles {
    await handle.value
  }
}

// CASE while_iterator_next expect=pass
func s17(stream: AsyncStream<Int>) async {
  var it = stream.makeAsyncIterator()
  while let next = await it.next() {
    log("\(next)")
  }
}

// CASE for_await_stream expect=pass
func s18(stream: AsyncStream<Int>) async {
  for await next in stream {
    await work(next)
  }
}

// CASE for_await_nested_per_item expect=fire
func s19(stream: AsyncStream<[Int]>) async {
  for await batch in stream {
    for item in batch {
      await work(item)
    }
  }
}
